name: 不死神体
description: 每局1次：受到致命伤害时保留1点生命，并进入濒死[2]。期间免疫致命伤害，结束时死亡。
skillCode: var hidan = context.rulePiece; if (context.piece.instanceId !== hidan.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var inDying = hidan.statusTags && hidan.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'hidan-dying'; }); if (inDying) return { success: false, message: '' }; var alreadyTriggered = (hidan.spentPassives || []).indexOf('hidan-undying') !== -1 || hidan.statusTags && hidan.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'hidan-undying-used'; }); if (alreadyTriggered) return { success: false, message: '' }; var effectiveDamage = context.damage || 0; if (effectiveDamage < hidan.currentHp) return { success: false, message: '' }; hidan.spentPassives = (hidan.spentPassives || []).concat(['hidan-undying']); hidan.currentHp = 1; addStatusEffectById(hidan.instanceId, { id: 'hidan-dying', name: '濒死', type: 'hidan-dying', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, remainingTurns: 2 }); addStatusEffectById(hidan.instanceId, { id: 'hidan-undying-used', name: '不死已触发', type: 'hidan-undying-used', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1 }); addRuleById(hidan.instanceId, 'rule-hidan-undying-tick'); return { success: true, blocked: true, message: hidan.name + '的不死神体触发！HP强制保留1点，进入濒死状态（下回合结束后死亡）' };
